title: Cervical Cancer Prevention
subtitle: Risk reduction, screening, evidence, and practical considerations for cervical cancer prevention.
evidence_strength: Established evidence from epidemiological studies, randomized trials, and international screening guidelines supports HPV vaccination and cervical cancer screening as effective measures in cervical cancer prevention. Evidence of lifestyle modification benefits is moderate and complementary. Limitations in some populations and access disparities remain areas of ongoing research.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
